crossRefs.note: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and…
They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.
‘Hear Yahweh’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne, you, your servants, and your people who enter in by…
Yahweh says: “Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor. Do no…
“Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against…
Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy…
Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”
You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.
Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.
I will go to the great men and will speak to them, for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?
translations.bsb: Then I said: “Hear now, O leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice?
translations.kjv: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
translations.asv: And I said, Hear, I pray you, ye heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: is it not for you to know justice?
